value.tagline: The original simulation - all 50 states, a bicameral Congress, and a presidential executive.
value.descriptor: A federal presidential republic with 50 states, a bicameral Congress, and a directly elected President who serves as both head of state and government.

upperChamber.name: Senate
upperChamber.description: 96 senators from 48 states, six-year staggered terms.

lowerChamber.name: House of Representatives
lowerChamber.description: 435 representatives, two-year terms. All revenue bills originate here.

value.alt: Seal of the President of the United States

executive.title: President
executive.signNote: The President may sign the bill into law or return it with a veto.

override.note: A two-thirds vote in both the House and Senate overrides a presidential veto.

value.upperNote: Both chambers are co-equal — the bill must pass the House and the Senate in identical form.

quirks.title: Presidential veto
quirks.body: Enrolled bills go to the President's desk to be signed or vetoed.

quirks.title: Veto override
quirks.body: Congress can override a veto with a two-thirds majority in both chambers.

quirks.title: Bicameral identical text
quirks.body: House and Senate must agree on the same text before enrollment.

tierSetting.name: Diplomatic Stance
tierSetting.description: Set the national diplomatic posture. Multilateral engagement boosts transparency and civic participation but slightly increases media polarization; isolationist focus reduces polarization but lowers public trust.

options.label: Isolationist
options.description: Reduce foreign commitments. Lowers media polarization but erodes public trust in government.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Pragmatic engagement. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Multilateral
options.description: Pursue broad international cooperation. Boosts government transparency but increases media polarization from foreign policy debate.

regionalTarget.name: Civic Engagement Initiative
regionalTarget.description: Launch a civic engagement program in one state, boosting civic participation and public trust in that region.

emergency.name: Diplomatic Crisis Response
emergency.description: Activate emergency diplomatic resources to address a crisis, temporarily boosting public trust and government transparency.

tierSetting.name: Fiscal Policy
tierSetting.description: Set the federal fiscal stance. Expansionary spending boosts GDP and reduces poverty but worsens the budget balance; austerity improves fiscal health but slows growth.

options.label: Austerity
options.description: Tight fiscal discipline. Improves budget balance but slows GDP growth and increases poverty pressure.

options.label: Moderate
options.description: Balanced fiscal approach. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Expansionary
options.description: Increased federal spending. Boosts GDP growth and reduces poverty but worsens the deficit.

allocation.name: Federal Grants Allocation
allocation.description: Allocate the federal grants pool across all 50 states. Each state receives a percentage of the total pool. Must sum to 100%.

regionalTarget.name: Economic Development Zone
regionalTarget.description: Designate one state for targeted economic development grants, boosting GDP growth and reducing poverty in that region.

emergency.name: Emergency Economic Stimulus
emergency.description: Deploy emergency stimulus funding to a state experiencing economic distress, delivering a large temporary GDP boost.

bondProfile.name: Sovereign Bond Maturity Profile
bondProfile.description: Set the split of quarterly sovereign debt issuance across 1-year, 2-year, and 5-year maturities.

tierSetting.name: Military Readiness
tierSetting.description: Set the national military readiness posture. Elevated readiness boosts public safety confidence but increases fiscal pressure; reduced readiness saves budget at the cost of public confidence.

options.label: Reduced
options.description: Scaled-back military operations. Lower force upkeep and readiness across the order of battle: the saving shows in the budget, the loss shows in public confidence.

options.label: Standard
options.description: Normal operational readiness across the force. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Elevated
options.description: Heightened military readiness. Raises the readiness every formation trains toward, at greater upkeep and with a standing army's cost to social cohesion at home.

regionalTarget.name: Military Base Investment
regionalTarget.description: Expand military facilities in one state. That state benefits from improved public trust and social cohesion through military employment and community presence.

emergency.name: National Guard Deployment
emergency.description: Deploy National Guard units to a state facing a crisis, delivering a large temporary boost to public safety confidence.

tierSetting.name: Enforcement Priority
tierSetting.description: Set the federal enforcement priority. Tough-on-crime reduces crime rates but increases incarceration; rehabilitation focus lowers incarceration and recidivism but allows crime to creep up.

options.label: Rehabilitation
options.description: Focus on reform and reentry programs. Reduces incarceration and recidivism but crime rate increases slightly.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Balanced enforcement approach. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Tough on Crime
options.description: Aggressive prosecution and sentencing. Reduces crime rate but increases incarceration.

regionalTarget.name: Anti-Corruption Task Force
regionalTarget.description: Deploy a federal anti-corruption task force to one state, accelerating improvement in the corruption index.

emergency.name: Federal Law Enforcement Surge
emergency.description: Surge federal law enforcement resources into a state with critically high crime, delivering a large temporary crime reduction.

tierSetting.name: Conservation Stance
tierSetting.description: Set the federal land management priority. Preservation expands protected areas and improves climate resilience but restricts economic activity; extraction opens land for development but degrades environmental metrics.

options.label: Extraction
options.description: Open federal lands for resource development. Reduces protected land and air quality but boosts regional economic activity.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Mixed-use land management. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Preservation
options.description: Expand conservation areas and tighten environmental regulations. Increases protected land and air quality but slows economic growth.

regionalTarget.name: Conservation Investment
regionalTarget.description: Direct federal conservation funding to one state, boosting protected land and climate resilience in that region.

emergency.name: Environmental Disaster Response
emergency.description: Deploy emergency environmental cleanup resources to a state facing an ecological crisis, delivering a large temporary boost to air quality and climate resilience.

tierSetting.name: Farm Policy
tierSetting.description: Set the federal agricultural policy direction. Subsidized farming reduces food insecurity and poverty but increases spending; market-driven policy boosts small business formation but allows food insecurity to rise.

options.label: Market-Driven
options.description: Reduce farm subsidies and let markets set prices. Boosts small business formation but food insecurity rises.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Balanced agricultural support. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Subsidized
options.description: Expand farm subsidies and nutrition programs. Reduces food insecurity but slightly reduces small business formation.

regionalTarget.name: Rural Development Grant
regionalTarget.description: Direct rural development funding to one state, reducing food insecurity and poverty in that region.

emergency.name: Emergency Food Assistance
emergency.description: Deploy emergency food distribution and nutrition assistance to a state facing acute food insecurity.

tierSetting.name: Trade Policy
tierSetting.description: Set the national trade stance. Protectionist policy supports domestic industry at the cost of higher consumer prices; free trade reduces prices but increases competitive pressure on domestic firms.

options.label: Protectionist
options.description: Domestic-first trade policy. Boosts small business formation but increases cost of living through tariffs.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Balanced trade policy. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Free Trade
options.description: Open trade policy. Reduces cost of living through cheaper imports but slightly reduces domestic business formation.

regionalTarget.name: Enterprise Zone
regionalTarget.description: Designate one state as a federal enterprise zone. Businesses in that state receive investment benefits, delivering a GDP growth boost.

emergency.name: Emergency Business Relief
emergency.description: Deploy emergency small business grants and trade relief in a state experiencing economic hardship, delivering a temporary GDP boost.

tierSetting.name: Labor Policy
tierSetting.description: Set the federal labor regulatory stance. Pro-worker regulations increase wages and reduce inequality but raise unemployment; deregulation boosts employment but widens income inequality.

options.label: Deregulated
options.description: Ease labor regulations. Reduces unemployment but widens income inequality and lowers workplace safety.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Balanced labor regulation. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Pro-Worker
options.description: Strengthen worker protections and minimum wage. Reduces inequality and boosts wages but slightly increases unemployment.

regionalTarget.name: Workforce Development Program
regionalTarget.description: Direct federal job training and workforce development funding to one state, reducing unemployment and boosting social mobility.

emergency.name: Emergency Jobs Program
emergency.description: Deploy emergency federal employment and retraining programs to a state facing high unemployment.

secretary_of_health.department: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services

departmentByYear.name: U.S. Department of Health, Education, and Welfare
U.S. Department of Health and Human Services

tierSetting.name: Healthcare Model
tierSetting.description: Set the federal healthcare policy direction. Public expansion reduces uninsured rates and improves affordability but increases government spending; market-based approach reduces costs but leaves more people uninsured.

options.label: Market-Based
options.description: Reduce government health programs and promote private insurance. Improves affordability index through competition but uninsured rate rises.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Balanced public-private healthcare model. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Public Expansion
options.description: Expand public health coverage. Reduces uninsured rate and improves preparedness but increases fiscal pressure.

tierSettings.name: Education Focus
tierSettings.description: Set the federal education policy direction. Vocational focus improves near-term workforce skills; academic focus builds long-term test performance and college enrollment; balanced delivers steady improvement across both.

options.label: Vocational
options.description: Prioritize trade and vocational training. Boosts workforce skill faster but reduces academic test performance emphasis.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Balanced curriculum approach. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Academic
options.description: Prioritize academic excellence and college preparation. Accelerates test performance and college enrollment but does not directly help workforce skills.

tierSettings.name: Welfare Model
tierSettings.description: Set federal welfare and transfer generosity. Broad transfers cut poverty and inequality and lift mobility but weigh on the budget; lean transfers ease fiscal pressure at the cost of higher poverty and inequality.

options.label: Lean
options.description: Trim transfer programs. Eases the budget but poverty and income inequality drift up.

options.label: Standard
options.description: Maintain existing transfer programs. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Broad
options.description: Expand transfers and the social safety net. Cuts poverty and inequality and lifts social mobility, but increases fiscal pressure.

regionalTarget.name: Public Health Campaign
regionalTarget.description: Launch a focused public health campaign in one state, delivering a targeted improvement in healthcare affordability and preparedness.

emergency.name: Public Health Emergency
emergency.description: Declare a public health emergency in a state, deploying federal medical resources to dramatically reduce preventable mortality and boost preparedness.

secretary_of_hud.department: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development

tierSetting.name: Housing Stance
tierSetting.description: Set the federal housing policy direction. Affordable housing investment reduces homelessness and cost of living but increases spending; deregulation promotes development but may widen inequality.

options.label: Deregulated
options.description: Reduce housing regulations to spur development. Lowers cost of living but does less to address homelessness directly.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Balanced housing policy. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Affordable Focus
options.description: Invest heavily in affordable housing and homelessness programs. Reduces homelessness but increases cost pressure on housing markets.

regionalTarget.name: Urban Renewal Project
regionalTarget.description: Direct federal urban renewal funding to one state, reducing homelessness and boosting social mobility in that region.

emergency.name: Emergency Housing Assistance
emergency.description: Deploy emergency housing vouchers and temporary shelters to a state facing a homelessness crisis.

tierSetting.name: Infrastructure Focus
tierSetting.description: Set the national infrastructure investment priority. Highway focus improves road conditions but neglects transit; transit focus improves public transit but diverts highway funding.

options.label: Highway Focus
options.description: Prioritize highway and road investment. Improves road conditions but public transit quality declines.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Balanced infrastructure spending. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Transit Focus
options.description: Prioritize public transit and rail. Improves transit quality but road maintenance receives less funding.

regionalTarget.name: Infrastructure Investment Package
regionalTarget.description: Direct federal infrastructure funding to one state, closing the investment gap and improving road conditions in that region.

emergency.name: Emergency Infrastructure Repair
emergency.description: Deploy emergency repair and reconstruction resources to a state following infrastructure failure or natural disaster.

tierSetting.name: Energy Policy
tierSetting.description: Set the national energy strategy. Green transition accelerates renewable adoption and reduces emissions but strains grid reliability during transition; fossil focus maintains grid stability but increases emissions.

options.label: Fossil Focus
options.description: Maintain fossil fuel infrastructure. Keeps grid reliability high but renewable energy stalls and emissions increase.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: All-of-the-above energy strategy. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Green Transition
options.description: Accelerate renewable energy development. Boosts renewable share and reduces emissions but grid reliability faces transition pressure.

regionalTarget.name: Clean Energy Investment
regionalTarget.description: Direct federal clean energy funding to one state, boosting renewable energy share and reducing carbon emissions in that region.

emergency.name: Emergency Grid Stabilization
emergency.description: Deploy emergency resources to stabilize power grid infrastructure in a state facing reliability failures.

tierSetting.name: Education Focus
tierSetting.description: Set the federal education policy direction. Vocational focus improves near-term workforce skills; academic focus builds long-term test performance and college enrollment; balanced delivers steady improvement across both.

options.label: Vocational
options.description: Prioritize trade and vocational training. Boosts workforce skill faster but reduces academic test performance emphasis.

options.label: Balanced
options.description: Balanced curriculum approach. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Academic
options.description: Prioritize academic excellence and college preparation. Accelerates test performance and college enrollment but does not directly help workforce skills.

regionalTarget.name: Education Investment Priority
regionalTarget.description: Direct enhanced education funding to one state. That state receives accelerated improvement in graduation rates and test performance.

emergency.name: Emergency Education Initiative
emergency.description: Launch an emergency education program in a state, delivering a significant temporary boost to graduation rates and workforce skill development.

tierSetting.name: Veterans Funding
tierSetting.description: Set the federal veterans services funding level. Expanded funding improves healthcare access and reduces veteran homelessness but increases spending; streamlined approach saves budget but reduces service quality.

options.label: Streamlined
options.description: Reduce VA overhead and consolidate services. Saves budget but physician access and coverage decline.

options.label: Standard
options.description: Maintain current veterans services level. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Expanded
options.description: Expand VA healthcare and benefits programs. Improves physician access and reduces homelessness but adds fiscal pressure.

regionalTarget.name: Veterans Services Hub
regionalTarget.description: Establish an enhanced veterans services hub in one state, improving physician access and reducing veteran homelessness in that region.

emergency.name: Emergency Veterans Outreach
emergency.description: Deploy emergency veterans healthcare and housing outreach to a state facing acute service gaps.

tierSetting.name: Security Level
tierSetting.description: Set the national security posture. Heightened security reduces crime and violence but restricts migration and increases cost of living; relaxed stance promotes openness but may allow crime to increase.

options.label: Relaxed
options.description: Lighter security enforcement. Boosts migration rate and reduces cost of living pressure but crime rate increases slightly.

options.label: Standard
options.description: Balanced security enforcement. No additional metric effects.

options.label: Heightened
options.description: Enhanced security measures. Reduces crime rate but restricts migration and increases cost of living.

regionalTarget.name: Border Security Initiative
regionalTarget.description: Focus federal security resources on one state, reducing crime and boosting public trust in that region.

emergency.name: Emergency Security Declaration
emergency.description: Declare a security emergency in a state with critically high crime, deploying federal agents for a large temporary crime reduction.

secretary_of_interior.name: Resource Management Reform

secretary_of_agriculture.name: Farm Relief Program

secretary_of_agriculture.name: Rural Development Grant

secretary_of_labor.name: Employment Training Initiative

secretary_of_hud.name: Community Development Block Grant

secretary_of_transportation.name: Infrastructure Emergency Fund

secretary_of_transportation.name: Public Transit Expansion

secretary_of_energy.name: Grid Modernization Push

secretary_of_veterans.name: Veterans Housing Initiative

secretary_of_homeland.name: Heightened Security Protocol

secretary_of_homeland.name: Border Security Operation
secretary_of_homeland.description: Launch a border security operation to manage migration flows and strengthen enforcement, for a temporary adjustment to migration.
